item.title: The Duty of a Scholar
item.description:
📝 There was a joke at the time that although the National Security Agency had opened up in recent years and started taking their defensive role more seriously, the one aspect of cryptography which they would never discuss publicly was side channel attacks — and this itself constituted a side channel, revealing the importance they attributed to the field. " without that duty being limited to hazards arising from projects employing the Engineer in question: The duty "to disclose promptly" vests in any Engineer who recognizes that the hazard exists. As with responsible disclosure of software security vulnerabilities, however, the subject matter of this duty is limited in scope: There is no duty to report if work is being done inefficiently.
🔗 Read more: https://www.daemonology.net/blog/2026-10-31-The-Duty-of-a-Scholar.html

item.description:
